name: Core Critical Metals Corp.
summary: Core Critical Metals Corp. is a junior mineral exploration company that evaluates, explores and develops mineral properties in Canada, mainly for nickel, lithium, lead, zinc, copper and gold. It holds full interests in the Val-d'Or Senneville property and claims in the CNC Timmins property, and has option agreements covering the Bear River Tungsten Project and the Timmins East Project.
